legacy: All V3 data including subject10 and former test clips are development/regression only. Never call them new independent test.
selection: Both before/after recordings, first 20 seconds or full clip if shorter. Fixed before action-model inference. No crops based on predicted success. Retain video-native frame clock. All variants/repetitions for a subject share split.
annotations: Agent visual phase intervals from publisher videos before V4 inference. Provisional, no independent human adjudicator. Seated and standing are background; visible forward-lean is preparatory only, report separately; rising is observable lift/extension, not force-plate seat-off ground truth. Preserve original V3 official labels for regression separately.
training_augmentation: Train-only time dilation 1.5x/2x, clearly synthetic speed augmentation, not new real slow subjects or independent test. New side-view plus existing frontal/oblique sources; no angle-disjoint claim.
selection_rule: Development candidates must have zero sampled seated false rises; among them choose maximum rising F1. Protected walk/bend/fall decisions unchanged. Final full source-clock regression before freeze. No test-based tuning.
metrics: new standing_up P/R/F1, unknown as error
